games.name: PRIMAL SURVIVAL | Alpha Testing
games.desc:
[REVAMP ALPHA ACCESS]

Step into the late Pleistocene Epoch and survive as an early human descendant in the wild heart of ancient North America.

Hunt prehistoric animals, gather resources, craft tools, build shelter, unlock survival skills, and fight to stay alive in a dangerous open-world PvP survival experience.

Keybinds:

G - Open crafting
V - Open inventory
Z - Open skills
B - Place selected build
Left Ctrl / Right Ctrl - Shift lock
1, 2, 3 - Hotbar slots
R - Spear charge / special attack
Mouse 1 - Attack / interact with equipped tool

Console:

D-Pad Up - Crafting
D-Pad Right - Inventory
D-Pad Down - Skills
A / 🔳

⚠️ Alpha Notice:
This game is still in active development. Bugs are expected, and data saving is still being improved. Tools currently save between joins, but are lost on death.

Developed by Ebo_2289
